source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S48: FFill Stat Distortion
# ffill duplicates sparse observations, inflating stats.
# Pass sparse series to summary_table/histogram; ffill only for rendering.
# Also covers S82 (same concept in compute package).
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

ref = reference_stocks(ticker="QQQ")()
ref_close = ref.c

# Sparse series: rolling correlation
ret = returns(close)
ref_ret = returns(ref_close)
corr_60 = rolling_corr(window=60)(ret, ref_ret)

# CORRECT: pass sparse to summary_table for stats
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Stats',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Correlation Stats (sparse -- no ffill distortion)',
      row_size=1, col_size=1,
      col_headers=['Rolling Corr'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
      ])
)(corr_60)

# CORRECT: ffill only for line rendering
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling Correlation (ffill for display)',
    category='Correlation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Corr 60d', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=corr_60)
